title: A Taste of Summer – Homemade Preserves
snippet: A Taste of Summer – Homemade Preserves Jars filled with pickled vegetables, spicy adjika, and homemade specialties. In Kazakhstan, food preservation has a long tradition: the harvest from the warmer months is carefully stored to bring a taste of summer to the winter table. A part of everyday culture passed down from generation to generation. Credits : Gereon Wintz (Germany) The post A Taste of Summer – Homemade Preserves appeared first on Novastan English .

title: Olga Korotko: “The film is a comedy in its construction and a tragedy in its outcome”
snippet: Olga Korotko: “The film is a comedy in its construction and a tragedy in its outcome” In Crickets, It's Your Turn, Kazakh filmmaker Olga Korotko explores gender-based violence, complicity and the structures of power that sustain them. Ahead of the film's Spanish premiere in Barcelona, she speaks to Novastan about black humour, the strength of creativity and why her story extends far beyond Kazakhstan. snippet: Azerbaijan and Turkey have maintained close bilateral ties in recent decades.
